race.comment: BLUE ISLES (12) got going late out wide at Morphettville Parks 11 days ago to finish fourth. She cops a wider gate this time, but with the right trek into it in this easier assignment, she could break her win drought. MAGIC ISLAND (9) had an excuse when pulling up mildly lame at Morphettville last time out when following on from a couple of stout efforts to open this prep. Stick with him on an each-way basis. TORRITA (8) was not bad on a quick backup here nearly 7 weeks ago, and the freshen-up since then would have done her no harm. She can make full use of the pole position and can bounce straight back into the money here. WIN TO RETIRE (13) has found it hard to win another race and has followed her trainer over from WA. A recent trial was good, and any market confidence is worth following. YARRAWIZARDHARRY (2) needed the run fresh up on a track that was too testing for him. He can improve quickly on a firmer surface and is worth another chance. Include in all top 4 combos,
